pull_request.title: Infrastructure: replace progress dashboard with cumulative token usage
pull_request.head: codex/token-usage-dashboard
pull_request.body:
The unused progress dashboard mixed scientific-record validation with its Pages renderer/deployment. Retire that UI and workflow, and make GitHub Pages show cumulative observed project token usage with major feature markers on the time axis.

This PR is stacked on #59 (`codex/overleaf-online-sync`), which carries the conflict/CI repair and exact accounting backfill. Merge #59 first, then retarget this PR to main.

The replacement provides combined/input/output views, exact daily totals, linked merged-feature markers, keyboard point labels, and aggregate JSON download. It counts validated canonical turn observations once, uses recovery inventories only to corroborate counters and completion dates, and displays unknown coverage explicitly. Cached input and reasoning output remain subsets. Current observed data: **552,937,331 tokens across 183 disjoint closed turns through October 10**; the active October 12 turn and prior no-counting scopes remain excluded.

Scientific tracking/review records remain canonical. Their semantic validators, PR naming/tracking policy and public Git-evidence preparation move to `tools/project_records`; all 17 existing scientific/software test commands remain unchanged in a separate validation workflow. The old dashboard renderer/assets/deployment are removed; a retirement guide keeps historical documentation links valid.

Pages uses a read-only PR preview build and main-only GitHub Actions artifact deployment; generated site content is never pushed to a Git branch. The site is standard-library Python plus static HTML/CSS/JavaScript/SVG, with no new external package or installation. Downloaded data contains aggregates only, without private client paths, thread IDs or raw history.

Validation: 8 usage/site tests, JavaScript mode/keyboard checks, 28 retained record/review/policy tests and 33 logger/recovery/link tests pass. Project validation passes (58 tasks / 31 documents / 19 reviews); 152 paired session records validate. The built daily curve reconciles all five fields with the canonical journal. Desktop preview rendering and controls inspected; no separate mobile viewport test is claimed. Whitespace checks pass. Pages deployment occurs after merge.
